svg.title: Maknae service architecture
svg.desc: UML 2.5.1 deployment view of Maknae installed on a host as system services: each service's account and trust plane, and which flows are built, proposed or vision.
svg.text: UML 2.5.1 deployment view · What runs on the host, under which account, in which trust plane, and what may talk to what?

Solid = built. Dashed = proposed or post-mvp: designed, no code. Dotted = vision: NO ADR and NO code, unratified. The Agent Daemon, tool containers, per-tasker workspaces, the TUI, direct prompt delivery to the Egress Daemon,
and shared and dedicated modes are all vision.
Local. Logs in on the host.
CLI · the 0660 socket requires the group
tasking. The same binary runs the MVP agent
A terminal console for the operator. No ADR,
The remote door: channels and scheduler,
Maknae's trusted code, and the secrets
AppRole, PKI and KV. Holds the provider key.
Egress Daemon. Holds the provider key from
Vault and makes the model calls.
The sole PDP. Authorizes on metadata;
content passes through only on the prompt
workspace. The only containers in the
The autonomous agent runtime. Shared mode:
Knowledge Lake and memory. A policy
information point, never a decision point.
Config. Root-owned; the daemons read it.
One per tasker; a tool container mounts only its own.
Agent Daemon rw · tool containers rw
The governed corpus. Writes brokered by the kernel.
maknaed rw · lake ro · dreamer ro

HOST SERVICES. Maknae installs from rpm, deb and the macOS .pkg as system services, each under its own account: systemd on Linux, launchd on macOS. The only containers drawn are tool invocations, and they are vision; the OCI

Dockerfiles in packaging/oci are a deferred stub (#81). A containerized deployment (Compose or Kubernetes) is a possible future option, designed in design/container-architecture.md; this view is the baseline it would build

Built today: the maknae CLI, maknaed under _maknae and maknae-egress under _maknae-egress, with root-owned config and an append-only audit trail. maknaed logs in to Vault with its own AppRole and has its plane certificate signed; the

CLI self-mints its cli leaf with its own AppRole: the shipped model, which ADR-0006 supersedes in target (ADR-0005 amendment) and #116 (open) removes. Shipped code still relays prompt content through maknaed: the CLI sends each

session.prompt turn to maknaed, which forwards it to maknae-egress. Direct delivery to the Egress Daemon, with maknaed issuing only the grant, is vision. ADR-0023 (Proposed) decides that the loop is untrusted and is maknae agent, and

that a separate Rust egress process under _maknae-egress makes the model call at the kernel's direction. None of its decisions ratifies the Agent Daemon, tool containers, per-tasker workspaces, the TUI, direct prompt delivery, or
